# ISummerStaking
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/gov-contracts/src/interfaces/ISummerStaking.sol)

**Inherits:**
IStakingRewardsManagerBase

**Title:**
ISummerStaking

**Author:**
Summer.fi Protocol

Interface for the staking module used by Governance v2. Users stake SUMR with optional lockups (0–3y),
receiving non-transferable xSUMR 1:1 for governance while rewards are accounted on the weighted balance.

Design highlights and invariants:
- One aggregated NoLockup stake is always at index 0 for a portfolio (created lazily on first stake).
- Lockups > 0 live at indices > 0. A user may have up to MAX_AMOUNT_OF_STAKES (see implementation constant).
- Rewards are distributed on weighted balances; base `totalSupply` in the rewards manager tracks weighted sum.
- Bucket caps are governor-controlled and can be 0 (disabled) or type(uint256).max (uncapped).
- Early unstake penalties are forwarded to protocol treasury; no burn of SUMR occurs.
- xSUMR mint/burn is delegated to approved staking modules; governance manages module roles on xSUMR.


## Functions
### stakeLockup

Stake SUMMER tokens with a specified lockup period

Creates a new stake with weighted amount calculated based on lockup period

Transfers SUMMER tokens from caller and mints equivalent xSUMR tokens

Weighted amount formula: amount * (1 + 7e-16 * lockupPeriod^2) using 60.18 fixed-point

Emits StakedWithLockup and Staked events

Reverts if amount is 0, lockup period exceeds max, or bucket cap exceeded


```solidity
function stakeLockup(uint256 _amount, uint256 _lockupPeriod) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_amount`|`uint256`|The amount of SUMMER tokens to stake (must be > 0)|
|`_lockupPeriod`|`uint256`|The lockup period in seconds (0 to 3 years max)|


### stakeLockupOnBehalf

Stake SUMMER tokens with lockup period on behalf of another address

SUMMER tokens are transferred from caller, but stake and xSUMR go to receiver

Useful for protocol-level staking or delegation scenarios

Same validation and mechanics as stakeLockup()

Authorization: the caller MUST be on the receiver-managed authorization list.
The receiver adds/removes callers via `setAuthorization(caller, isAuthorized)`.
If the caller is not authorized by `_receiver`, the call reverts with
`Staking_NotAuthorized(caller, _receiver)`.


```solidity
function stakeLockupOnBehalf(address _receiver, uint256 _amount, uint256 _lockupPeriod) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_receiver`|`address`|The address that will receive the stake and xSUMR tokens|
|`_amount`|`uint256`|The amount of SUMMER tokens to stake (must be > 0)|
|`_lockupPeriod`|`uint256`|The lockup period in seconds (0 to 3 years max)|


### unstakeLockup

Unstake tokens from a specific stake position with penalty calculation

can only be called by the wallet that owns the stake, there is no onBehalf version due to the penalty

Applies penalty for early withdrawal based on remaining lockup time

Penalty formula: penalty% = 2% if remaining time < 110 days otherwise (timeRemaining / maxLockupPeriod) *
20%

Examples:
- 3yr lockup, immediate unstake: 20% penalty
- 3yr lockup, unstake after 1.5yr: 10% penalty
- 1yr lockup, immediate unstake: ~6.67% penalty
- After lockup ends: 0% penalty
- 0 lockup, immediate unstake: 0% penalty
- any lockup time, <110 days remaining: 2% penalty

Penalties are sent to protocol treasury

Emits UnstakedWithPenalty and Unstaked events

Reverts if amount is 0, stake index invalid, or insufficient balance


```solidity
function unstakeLockup(uint256 _stakeIndex, uint256 _amount) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_stakeIndex`|`uint256`|The index of the stake to unstake from (0-based)|
|`_amount`|`uint256`|The amount of tokens to unstake (must be > 0 and <= stake amount)|


### setAuthorization

Manage the caller authorization list for `stakeLockupOnBehalf`

Only the list owner (msg.sender) can modify their own authorization list

When authorized, `_authorizedCaller` may call `stakeLockupOnBehalf(msg.sender, ...)`


```solidity
function setAuthorization(address _authorizedCaller, bool _isAuthorized) external;
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_authorizedCaller`|`address`|The address to authorize or revoke for acting on behalf of the caller (receiver)|
|`_isAuthorized`|`bool`|True to authorize `_authorizedCaller`, false to revoke authorization|

### calculatePenaltyPercentage

Calculate the penalty percentage for early unstaking

Returns 0 if lockup period has ended

Formula: (timeRemaining / maxLockupPeriod) * maxPenalty

maxPenalty = 2% floor < 110 days, else 20% (0.2e18), maxLockupPeriod = 3 years

penaltyDisabled == true then 0


```solidity
function calculatePenaltyPercentage(address _user, uint256 _stakeIndex) external view returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_user`|`address`|The address of the stake owner|
|`_stakeIndex`|`uint256`|The index of the stake to calculate penalty for|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The penalty percentage in WAD format (18 decimals)|


### calculatePenalty

Calculate the penalty amount for unstaking a specific amount

Penalty = (penaltyPercentage * amount) / WAD


```solidity
function calculatePenalty(address _user, uint256 _amount, uint256 _stakeIndex) external view returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_user`|`address`|The address of the stake owner|
|`_amount`|`uint256`|The amount of tokens to unstake|
|`_stakeIndex`|`uint256`|The index of the stake|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The penalty amount in token units|


### calculateWeightedStake

Calculate the weighted stake amount for a given amount and lockup period

Formula: amount * (1 + 7e-16 * lockupPeriod^2) using 60.18 fixed-point

Longer lockups result in higher weighted amounts and more rewards

For 0 lockup period, multiplier is 1.0 (no boost)


```solidity
function calculateWeightedStake(uint256 _amount, uint256 _lockupPeriod) external pure returns (uint256);
```
**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`_amount`|`uint256`|The base amount to stake|
|`_lockupPeriod`|`uint256`|The lockup period in seconds|

**Returns**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`<none>`|`uint256`|The weighted stake amount for reward calculations|

## Events
### StakedWithLockup
Emitted when tokens are staked with a lockup period


```solidity
event StakedWithLockup(
    address indexed receiver,
    uint256 indexed stakeIndex,
    uint256 amount,
    uint256 lockupPeriod,
    uint256 weightedAmount
);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`receiver`|`address`|The address that staked the tokens|
|`stakeIndex`|`uint256`|The index of the stake that was staked|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The amount of tokens staked|
|`lockupPeriod`|`uint256`|The lockup period in seconds|
|`weightedAmount`|`uint256`|The weighted amount calculated for rewards|

### UnstakedWithPenalty
Emitted when tokens are unstaked with a penalty applied


```solidity
event UnstakedWithPenalty(
    address indexed receiver,
    uint256 indexed stakeIndex,
    uint256 unstakedAmount,
    uint256 penalty,
    uint256 returnAmount
);
```

**Parameters**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`receiver`|`address`|The owner of the stake that unstaked the tokens|
|`stakeIndex`|`uint256`|The index of the stake that was unstaked|
|`unstakedAmount`|`uint256`|The gross amount unstaked before penalty|
|`penalty`|`uint256`|The penalty amount sent to treasury|
|`returnAmount`|`uint256`|The net amount returned to user (unstakedAmount - penalty)|

## Errors
### Staking_InvalidAddress
Thrown when trying to use an invalid address (zero address)


```solidity
error Staking_InvalidAddress(string message);
```

### Staking_DirectStakeNotAllowed
Thrown when trying to use direct stake function instead of stakeLockup


```solidity
error Staking_DirectStakeNotAllowed(string message);
```

### Staking_DirectUnstakeNotAllowed
Thrown when trying to use direct unstake function instead of unstakeLockup


```solidity
error Staking_DirectUnstakeNotAllowed(string message);
```

### Staking_InvalidLockupPeriod
Thrown when lockup period is invalid (too long, ended, etc.)


```solidity
error Staking_InvalidLockupPeriod(string message);
```

### Staking_InvalidStakeIndex
Thrown when stake index is invalid or out of bounds


```solidity
error Staking_InvalidStakeIndex(string message);
```

### Staking_InsufficientBalance
Thrown when trying to unstake more than available balance


```solidity
error Staking_InsufficientBalance();
```

### StakeOnBehalfOfNotSupported
Thrown when trying to use stakeOnBehalfOf (not supported)


```solidity
error StakeOnBehalfOfNotSupported();
```

### UnstakeOnBehalfOfNotSupported
Thrown when trying to use unstakeAndWithdrawOnBehalfOf (not supported)


```solidity
error UnstakeOnBehalfOfNotSupported();
```

### Staking_MaxStakesReached
Thrown when user has reached the maximum number of stakes allowed


```solidity
error Staking_MaxStakesReached();
```

### Staking_BucketCapExceeded
Thrown when trying to stake amount that would exceed bucket cap


```solidity
error Staking_BucketCapExceeded();
```

### Staking_InvalidAmount
Thrown when trying to stake/unstake amount that is invalid


```solidity
error Staking_InvalidAmount(string message);
```

### Staking_NotAuthorized
Thrown when caller is not authorized to act on behalf of the owner


```solidity
error Staking_NotAuthorized(address caller, address receiver);
```


**Properties**

|Name|Type|Description|

### UserStake
Structure representing a user's individual stake with lockup details

User stake element stored per portfolio. Implementation reserves index 0 for the no-lockup aggregate.
For indices > 0, each element corresponds to an independent lockup position with its own end time.
`weightedAmount` is precomputed to avoid recalculating the quadratic multiplier on every read.


```solidity
struct UserStake {
    uint256 amount;
    uint256 weightedAmount;
    uint256 lockupEndTime;
    uint256 lockupPeriod;
}
```

**Properties**

|Name|Type|Description|
|----|----|-----------|
|`amount`|`uint256`|The actual amount of tokens staked|
|`weightedAmount`|`uint256`|The weighted amount used for reward calculations (amount * multiplier)|
|`lockupEndTime`|`uint256`|Timestamp when the lockup period ends|
|`lockupPeriod`|`uint256`|Original lockup period duration in seconds|

## Enums
### Bucket
Lockup buckets categorizing stakes by lockup period duration

Each bucket has configurable caps and different lockup period ranges


```solidity
enum Bucket {
    NoLockup, // 0 days - immediate withdrawal with no lockup
    ShortTerm, // 1second - 14 days - disabled by default (cap = 0)
    TwoWeeksToThreeMonths, // <90 days - 2 weeks-3 months lockup period
    ThreeToSixMonths, // <180 days - 3-6 months lockup period
    SixToTwelveMonths, // <365 days - 6-12 month lockup period
    OneToTwoYears, // <730 days - 1-2 years lockup period
    TwoToThreeYears // <1095 days - 2-3 years lockup period
}
```
